title: The receipt of every successful board mutation (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Never carries an estate-wide sequence number (C3) or another Project's data: an unknown member is refused.

repeated.description: true: the same idempotency key and digest were already stored, and this is that receipt; for a com.submit of a finding under a fresh key, the sender Project's retained finding with the same dedupeKey already stands, and this is that finding's receipt, no message stored (DEC-0080); for a com.progress note, the note was already posted under this attempt and key; for com.read_ack, the reader had already marked the message read. com.renew and com.progress without a note store nothing and answer false.

message.description: The message this call stored or acknowledged.

at.description: When the message was stored, or for com.read_ack when the reader first marked it read.

then.description: Only a settled request can have been settled by the owner (DEC-0081).

request.description: The request this call created or moved, after the call. After the estate owner settled it, settledBy is owner; absent, the responder settled it (DEC-0081).

leaseExpiresAt.description: Database time; the caller's clock is not authoritative.

slot.description: The responder slot the caller holds after com.enroll, com.responder_replace, com.renew or com.progress.

attempt.description: The attempt com.claim opened, or whose lease com.renew or com.progress extended: the values the caller's next fence carries.

transferred.description: com.responder_replace with transfer.requests (DEC-0078): one entry per accepted request the replacement transferred, each request once, giving its revision and the attempt the new holder continues under, so its next fence on that request carries these values (expectedRevision from revision). Only com.responder_replace answers it, and only for requests it transferred.

marked.description: A bulk com.read_ack (DEC-0098): how many messages this call marked read.

alreadyRead.description: A bulk com.read_ack: how many of them the reader had already marked read.

more.description: A com.read_ack of a thread up to a message: true when more than 1000 messages qualified and only the oldest 1000 were marked; call again. Absent otherwise.

noResponder.description: Only in the requester's own com.submit receipt for a request (DEC-0098): nobody can answer that capability for that Project now (no slot has a holder and no live board.respond grant exists). The request is stored: a reply from the target answers it and a responder may come later.

message.description: For a person: at most 300 characters.
